On the evening of 21 June 2030, at the Maison Delorme saleroom in Paris’s 8th arrondissement, at 19.12 during the sale, Auguste Delorme (71) collapsed beside the rostrum; he died on the way to hospital.

His severe peanut and walnut allergy was known to his family and staff. He always carried his adrenaline pen in his jacket’s inside pocket; the pen was not found.

Present in the back room and the saleroom: Céline Delorme, Antoine Brassard, the auctioneer Martin Faure, the assistant Carla Lopes, the lawyer Vincent Morel.
INCIDENT REPORT
Send the gloves for analysis
Request a search warrant for Antoine Brassard’s briefcase and car

With the branch chief’s approval:

· In Antoine Brassard’s briefcase, an unused adrenaline pen; ‘A. Delorme’ on the prescription label.
· In the same bag, a small bottle of walnut oil with a dropper; a restoration supplies invoice in Brassard’s name, 19 June.
· In the car’s glovebox, Lakeshore Freight manifests: a warehouse address in Pilsen, Chicago; every shipment’s provenance letter signed ‘Dr E. Varga’.
· On the phone, at 19.30, a message to a Chicago number saved as ‘E.V.’: ‘Paris is closed. The goods are on their way.’
ANTOINE BRASSARD’S BRIEFCASE AND CAR — SEARCH

The autopsy showed the allergen passed through the glove, the glove analysis that the oil was only on the inside of that pair, and the back room camera the man at the tray and the jacket. The search, opened on two grounds, gave the pen, the oil and the manifests bound for Chicago.
Every road in Paris met at one table. The goods changed place: Chicago.
Paris — June 2030

Antoine Brassard, Maison Delorme’s shipping director, learned that Auguste Delorme, his employer of forty years, would give all the Lakeshore files to bube on Monday. On the evening of the auction, in the back room, he smeared walnut oil inside the top pair of gloves reserved for the chairman and took the adrenaline pen from the hanging jacket. Delorme touched his lip while showing the bowl; Brassard pretended to run for the pen.
Who killed Auguste Delorme?
